effect_description_eng:
When any of your Digimon would digivolve into this card, reduce the digivolution cost by 1 for each color in your opponent's trash.
[Your Turn] For every 2 colors in your opponent's trash, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) and +2000 DP.
